title: My Favourite TV Show
description: Three short recordings about TV shows: two friends, a boy talking and a phone message.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Two friends
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Ben talking about TV.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Ben, did you watch the cooking show last night?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: No, Mai. I watched a nature programme about whales. It was really good.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My favourite show is Cook Club. Four children make a dinner and a chef gives them marks.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: It sounds fun. When is it on? I never know which shows are good, so I always ask you.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Every Thursday at six o'clock, after the news. No, sorry, before the news. The news starts at half past six.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I'll watch it this Thursday. I like funny shows best.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: It is funny! Last week a boy put salt in the cake.

parts.title: Part 2 · Minh's favourite show
parts.intro: You will hear Minh talking about his favourite TV show.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: My favourite TV show is called Space Detectives. It's about a girl, Zoe, and her robot dog, Max.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: They fly to different planets and solve problems. My favourite character is Max because he's very funny and he can sing.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: My brother likes the show too, but he doesn't like the music. He says it's too loud.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I watch it on Saturday morning with my grandfather. We eat toast and drink hot chocolate while we watch.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: There are three seasons, and I have seen them all twice. I think the next season will be even better, but we must wait until next summer.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone message
parts.intro: You will hear Linh leave a message for her friend Nam.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Nam. It's Linh. Guess what? My favourite singer is going to be on TV tonight!

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The programme starts at seven o'clock on channel four.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: It's on for one hour, so it finishes at eight. Do you want to come to my house and watch it?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: My mum is making pizza. Bring your sister if you want. Call me back after school. It will be a really nice evening, and we can talk about the show afterwards.
